entries.basis: Variant: QQ Ice Cream at pre-sale, RMB 29,900-43,900. 120/170 km NEDC (scored on 170 km; NEDC not CLTC); 20 kW, 85 Nm, top speed 100 km/h; 1,960 mm wheelbase, three doors, four seats. Null: charging (no DC rate in launch sources; the 10 kW figure seen only in a Yiche aggregate, not used), 0-100 km/h and driver assist unpublished. Value 3: priced where the Wuling Mini EV Macaron (RMB 37,600-43,600) sits, but larger (CnEVPost). Reviews: original China launch family only. Autohome owner 落花伊人盎 (Sep 20, 2022; 6,850 km) and Yiche owner ych_AHgNyx180757 (Oct 12, 2022; four months) identify 2022 170-km Sundae. 车评社Auto’s Jan 6, 2022 Sohu article reports a Wuhu launch drive; tested battery trim unspecified, so its high-speed caveat is family context, not measured 170-km range. Distinct accounts/publications; owners are not instrumented tests. No later Queen/Peach or Jetour export findings substituted. Scores unchanged; sentiment estimates describe excerpts.
